Coastal Governorate flood forecast report

Governorate: [[${eventRecord.governorate_name}]]
Warning level: [[${warningLevel}]]

Forecast time: [[${timeRecord.t0}]]

A coastal flooding event in [[${eventRecord.governorate_name}]] is defined as an event where flooding occurs in at least one district within the coming 5 days.

The probability of such an event occurring in the next 5 days is [[${eventRecord.event_probability}]]%.

  • ● Green P = 0%
  • ● Yellow 0% < P <= 15%
  • ● Orange 15% < P < 25%
  • ● Red P >= 25%
